system.description:
• Effect: Once per encounter, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP or below, recover one expended spell slot of a level up to half that creature's Level (rounded up, minimum 1st level). It must be a foe that fought your side this encounter, not helpless, and not summoned, created or controlled by your side.
  • Example: kill a Level 6 creature, recover up to a 3rd level slot

activities.name: Dark Harvest
activities.text: When you drop a foe to 0 HP (one that fought your side this encounter, not helpless, not summoned or controlled by your side), recover one expended slot of level up to half its Level (rounded up, minimum 1st).
